Your fleet scheduler and a part-time pair of hands
Votre pipeline open source et un stage é…
Hi Claire, I saw that Acme Robotics is open-sourcing its fleet
scheduler for warehouses, and the focus on real warehouse
Quarry Labs search infra, part-time from…
workloads stood out to me. I built DocuAsk, a RAG assistant that
chunked and embedded 3,500 pages of documentation, so careful
data handling at scale matters to me. I can commit about 20 hours
a week, starting October 12, or join you for a summer 2027
internship. My working hours overlap fully with Paris and Berlin.
Would you be open to a short call this week?
FOLLOW-UP (same thread, after the first email)
Hi Claire, one more thought on the scheduler: DocuAsk had to cite
the exact source page for every answer, and I would enjoy
applying the same rigour to your tooling. I am happy to adapt to
